title: Sentence Stats
prompt: A writing assistant needs basic stats for a sentence. Write a function that returns { words, characters } where words counts non-empty space-separated words and characters counts all non-space characters.

explanation.beginner:
Example: sentenceStats("hello world") produces {"words":2,"characters":10}. The result must follow this precise rule: A writing assistant needs basic stats for a sentence. Write a function that returns { words, characters } where words counts non-empty space-separated words and characters counts all non-space characters. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “ignores extra spaces for words”: input ["  one   two  "] produces {"words":2,"characters":6}. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
